name: audemic
description: Find academic papers and listen to them narrated, section by section, with the text alongside.

interface.longDescription:
Audemic turns academic papers into audio you can actually get through. Ask ChatGPT to find research on any topic, see each paper's key statements at a glance, and press play to hear it narrated section by section, with the section's text, tables, figures and formulas shown alongside. ChatGPT can summarise or explain any section while you listen. Save papers to your Audemic library to keep listening on the web and mobile apps.

Audemic is for students, researchers and anyone who learns better by listening, including readers with dyslexia or ADHD. You sign in with your Audemic account, and Audemic only reads the papers in that account's library and in Audemic's public research library.

Limitations: Audemic can't upload or delete papers from ChatGPT; uploads happen in the Audemic web app or browser extension. Narration for a section that hasn't been played before can take a minute to generate. Some papers show a preview here and continue in the Audemic app.
capabilities: Search Audemic's library of academic papers
List the papers in your Audemic library
Play a paper's narration section by section
Show each section's text, tables, figures and formulas
Read a section so ChatGPT can summarise or explain it
Save papers to your Audemic library

Open the first paper in my Audemic library so I can listen to it

positive.description: Search the research library by topic
positive.prompt: Find recent research papers in Audemic on audio-first reading for students with dyslexia.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Audemic papers card listing matching papers, best match first, each with title, authors, journal and year, and Listen and Save buttons.
Shows the Audemic papers card with the test account's saved papers.

positive.description: Open a paper and listen to it
positive.prompt: Open the first paper in my Audemic library so I can listen to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Audemic player with the paper's title and key statements. Pressing play narrates the first section and shows its text; choosing another section switches both the audio and the text.

positive.description: Summarise one section of an open paper
positive.prompt: Summarise the methods section of that paper in plain English.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the paper's methods section and summarises it accurately in plain English, without inventing details that aren't in the section.

positive.description: Save a search result to the library
positive.prompt: Find papers on mindfulness and interoception, then save the top result to my Audemic library.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches, saves the first result and confirms it was saved; the paper then appears when the user lists their Audemic library.

negative.description: Uploading isn't supported: ChatGPT should say papers are uploaded in the Audemic web app or browser extension, and call no Audemic tool.
negative.prompt: Upload this PDF to my Audemic library.

negative.description: Deleting isn't supported: ChatGPT should say it can't delete papers here and point to the Audemic web app, and call no Audemic tool.
negative.prompt: Delete every paper in my Audemic library.

negative.description: Another person's library isn't reachable: Audemic only reads the signed-in account, so ChatGPT should say it can't access someone else's library.
negative.prompt: Show me the papers in my colleague's Audemic library.

review.commerce_description: Audemic doesn't sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: search Audemic's research library, open papers and listen to them section by section with the text, tables, figures and formulas alongside, have ChatGPT summarise or explain a section, and save papers to your Audemic library.
